description: This file contains an extension for the CanvasWindowController class, providing window creation, presentation, positioning, and lifecycle management functionalities specifically for window and panel types within a macOS application.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Constructs and returns an NSWindow object configured for either a window or a panel based on the presentation type.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Displays the panel anchored to a position relative to an anchor point, bringing it to the front and activating it.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Calculates and updates the panel’s position on screen based on anchor provider and placement preferences.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates the default top-right position for a panel, ensuring minimum size constraints.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel to a specified rectangle within the bounds of a screen.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the screen corresponding to a given anchor point.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Finds the screen that contains the current mouse cursor position.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame is significantly visible within a screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Adjusts a frame to be fully within visible bounds, respecting minimum size constraints.

methods.name: windowWillClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the window is closing, updating visibility state.

methods.name: windowDidMove
methods.description: Persists window position after move events.

methods.name: windowDidEndLiveResize
methods.description: Persists window size after resize events.

methods.name: persistFrameIfPanel
methods.description: Stores the current frame of the panel for session restoration.
